description: Everything an entity (protocol, asset, stablecoin, curator) depends on, transitively, as a graph. Useful for tracing what a protocol or stablecoin ultimately relies on. Entity ids appear in dependency graphs, for example protocol:morpho-blue. Unknown ids answer 404 and invalid arguments 400 before any payment; 503 while data refreshes; charged only for a 200. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base (x402), charged only for a successful answer.

entity.description: Entity id: protocol:<slug>, stablecoin:<id>, oracle:<name>, curator:<name> or issuer:<name>, as found in dependency graphs.

name: get_closure
